clock.name: perf_counter_ns
clock.utc_mapping: bracketed startup/readiness/header/exit/final anchors; no guarantee against between-anchor UTC steps

startup_coordination: owned strace child suspended on one reverse port; verified OS observer ready before collector resumes that same endpoint
target_stderr_scope: owned target plus strace diagnostics combined

event_loss.status: EventPipe analysis required; strace provides no kernel loss count

limits: strace, EventPipe, startup coordination, proc polling and rundown perturb this SAME target execution.
futex wall intervals include scheduling/ptrace and may restart; they are not CPU time or proof of a managed lock owner.
Native syscalls/CPU counters and runtime GC episodes require bounded clock/TID correlation before attribution.
Buffer payload contents are suppressed; caller must supply credential-free arguments and fixture output.
Child stdout/stderr and syscall file/address metadata are retained, not scrubbed.
I/O includes diagnostic IPC; logical byte returns/mmap/waits are not physical disk latency.
Scheduler counters remain sampled partial lifetime; no exact CSwitch or privilege changes.
Restarted/incomplete/unparsed raw records remain explicit; unknown native loss is never zero.
source_provenance_scope: Frozen import-time source bytes match loaded function/method code and inventory; fingerprints checked before/after capture. Globals/defaults/imported bindings are not attested; trusted caller/checkout, not immutable execution attestation.
prelaunch_hashing_scope: Hashing/preparation can prime filesystem caches; not cold disk
header_timing_scope: post-resume acknowledgment upper bound, never the exact resume clock
target_exit_clock_scope: upper bound after strace followed-group completion; exact target exit remains in native raw lifecycle

summary.scope: diagnostic sampled native OS counters only, never exact scheduler events or benchmark evidence
summary.initial_coverage: first successful snapshot; startup before it is not event-traced
summary.timing_clock: perf_counter_ns; legacy monotonic_ns is distinct and must not be joined to QPC
summary.flush_policy: flush each JSON line; no fsync/power-loss guarantee

capabilities.scheduler: per-thread cumulative schedstat and context-switch samples; not event trace
capabilities.schedstat_zero_policy: raw zero is not evidence of no wait; require supported/enabled counters
capabilities.io_scope: logical/syscall and accounted storage counters if supported, not file latency

native_summary.scope: ptrace-observed syscall intervals/counts, not physical disk latency or benchmark timing
native_summary.loss_status: strace supplies no kernel event-loss counter; incomplete/unparsed input retained
